title: Verify synchronization of delivery initiation
gherkin:
Feature: Delivery Lifecycle Synchronization
  Scenario: Synchronize delivery initiation
    Given a delivery is initiated
    When the delivery status is updated
    Then the status should be synchronized across all systems
rationale: To ensure that when a delivery is initiated, all systems reflect this change immediately, maintaining consistency.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases for the requirement of delivery lifecycle synchronization, ensuring that all stages of the delivery process are properly synchronized across systems.
